interactive.$description: Neon glow at rest on interactive elements such as buttons (BR-10, ADR-0051): pink. Edges only, never text (ADR-0052).

interactiveHover.$description: Neon glow on a hovered pink interactive element (BR-10, ADR-0051). Edges only, never text (ADR-0052).

secondary.$description: Neon glow at rest around a yellow interactive element (BR-10, ADR-0051). Edges only, never text (ADR-0052).

secondaryHover.$description: Neon glow on a hovered yellow interactive element (BR-10, ADR-0051). Edges only, never text (ADR-0052).

overlay.$description: Shadow of overlays (modal, slideover): none (ADR-0054). The outline lifts an overlay off the black page (ADR-0053).

opacity.$description: How much of the page the backdrop of an overlay (modal, slideover) covers: 0.85 (ADR-0054, ADR-0029).

toast.$description: Stacking order of toasts: 100, above every overlay (ADR-0054).
